title: Meet Alexandremix
body_markdown:
It looks like Portugal is famous not only for its soccer legends but for young and talented professional gamers as well. So, here’s one more aspiring Portuguese esports athlete for you — Alexandremix, our brilliant Warzone PRO!⁠ ⁠
⁠
Alexandre Calvario, aka Alexandremix, is a 27-year-old software developer and tech enthusiast. Always in tune with new technology trends and cutting-edge gadgets, Alexandre is outgoing and sociable. An avid festival fan and amateur photographer, he is indeed a man of many hobbies and talents, but there’s one thing that’s been a part of him for as long as he can remember.⁠
⁠
‘I’ve always played video games,’ he says, talking about his greatest passion. ‘It is in my blood.’⁠
⁠
A streamer with a growing following, Alexandre plays Warzone on high professional levels, with his killcount, wins, and score in the Top 0.1%. His other stats are no less impressive:⁠
⁠
1,392 wins⁠
63,074 kills⁠
3.13 K/D⁠
43,096,744 score⁠
18.31% win rate⁠
⁠
With LegionFarm for over a year, Alexandremix is one of our customers’ favorite Pros and a proud owner of the elite VIP status. ⁠
⁠
At LegionFarm, Alexandre happily unites his social side and love for communication with his gamer self to make a great coach and fantastic game buddy. ‘I love it! I made a lot of friends in LF, and everyone is so great,’ he shares.⁠
⁠
Wanna play with Alexandremix? Sign up here at legionfarm.com and book your session!⁠
